blocks.html: Dieser Mercedes 280SL "Pagode" erhielt in unserer Manufaktur eine umfassende Vollrestauration in allen Details. Karosserie, Technik, Chrom, Elektrik, Lackierung, Polsterung in Echtleder, Verdeck, Zierhölzer u.dgl.
blocks.htmlEn: This Mercedes 280 SL Pagoda received a full restoration in every detail: bodywork, mechanics, chrome, electrics, paint, genuine leather upholstery, hood and wood trim.
